''See also: [[Prince Seishen Kiro Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seishen Kiro is the first prince of the [[Seishen Kingdom]] and the son of [[King Dakata]]. A trained and disciplined leader, he has demonstrated a commitment to serving his people and the [[Sage]]. In combat, he utilizes a [[sword]] and a heavy metal shield featuring a lion's face, which can be used to generate protective domes of [[madra]] and [[soulfire]]. He has also been noted for his ability to defeat [[Golds]]. Kiro's life was significantly impacted by an encounter with [[Lindon]], whose [[Blackflame cannon]] caused him lasting damage. Following this event, he and his companions sought life-aspect treasures to aid his recovery. Kiro eventually died in a [[vault]], an event that left his younger brother, Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji, resentful and caused significant instability for the [[Seishen Kingdom]]. His death was a pivotal moment that led to various political and personal consequences for his family and subordinates.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The prince wears armor constructed entirely of [[madra]] that emits a silver-and-yellow corona, though the suit is currently falling apart. He carries a red-hot heavy metal disc shield decorated with a lion's face and wields a [[sword]] characterized by blue sparks on the blade.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the first prince of the [[Seishen Kingdom]] and son of [[King Dakata]], Kiro possesses a noble bloodline. He acts as an ally to Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira and Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji, though his sister Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji has felt resentment toward him.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kiro follows a [[Path]] containing [[aspects]] of earth and force. His combat repertoire includes a [[Striker technique]] used with his [[sword]] to produce blue lightning, as well as the ability to launch a bright blue lance.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Underlord}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Prince Seishen Kiro is the first prince of the [[Seishen Kingdom]] and the son of [[King Dakata]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> While searching for the [[Blackflame]] boy alongside Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira, Kiro utilized various combat techniques.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c10">''Underlord'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref> His [[madra]]-based armor glows with a silver-and-yellow corona, though it eventually begins to fall apart.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref> A practitioner of a [[Path]] with earth and force [[aspects]], he wields a [[sword]] that produces blue sparks or lightning and carries a red-hot shield shaped like a heavy metal disc with a lion's face.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> Despite being a [[Truegold]], this noble-blooded star [[Underlord]] is an ally to Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira and Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji who may one day reach the rank of Overlord.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> During combat, Kiro launched a bright blue lance at [[Lindon]]'s back, marking him as an opponent [[Lindon]] may face again before reaching [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" />}}
